name: douyin-related
doc: related-recommendations of one item (capability E RelatedGraph — the only graph-shaped face, 1-hop adjacency). Evidence: corpus/f2 POST_RELATED param table (note the camelCase awemePcRecRawData unlike the snake_case family) GET /aweme/v1/web/aweme/related?aweme_id=... -> 6-key envelope {aweme_list, chime_video_list, filter_infos, has_more, log_pb, status_code}, aweme_list = 10 items with full author/statistics/video/create_time; has_more=1 but NO pagination cursor — single-page semantics (10 per hop) on both synth oracle and real site (f2 evidence). The K-hop walk, node/edge budget and cycle guard live in the engine atom, not the contract.
